name: Littoral-Sanctum

civilization.name: The Pale Assemblies
civilization.notes: An atom-forged theocracy that believes the planet is a sealed reliquary, and forbids its opening.

description: Sand owns this world, in colors from bone-white to burnt sienna, migrating with the seasons before a patient wind. Where the gusts strip it away, a nearby asteroid belt emerge like the bones of the planet.

Breathable air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything. Their beacons answer incoming ships in a hundred borrowed languages.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on copper, solar potential and rare flora are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
